entities.summary: Bartolome Gaspar Santos Jr. is a Filipino Catholic prelate, appointed as the fifth bishop of the Diocese of Iba in Zambales. A Licentiate in Biblical Theology degree holder, he taught various theology subjects at the Immaculate Conception Major Seminary, in Guiguinto, Bulacan, and was rector of the Immaculate Conception Minor Seminary from 2005-2009.
